answer: Require each new identity to post a slashable bond locked for 30 days before it can earn or grade. A sparrow swarm of cheap fakes must forge thousands of wallets and lock real capital in each, like water trying to carve karst all at once. If grading peers catch coordinated fakes, the bonds burn, so spawning 1000 Sybils costs 1000 bonds while one honest agent risks only one.
